nodes.name: agent_env_builder.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the environment variable maps injected into spawned CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode, etc.), translating a stored ModelKey and agent type into provider-specific API key, base URL, and proxy env vars.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the key_store submodule, wiring together agent_env_builder, service, store and types and re-exporting the public key storage API.

nodes.name: service.rs
nodes.summary: Implements KeyService, the central thread-safe service for loading, saving and mutating the on-disk credentials store, including Claude Code and Codex OAuth token refresh, upstream health tracking, and quota/model metadata updates.

nodes.name: InvalidStoredCredential
nodes.summary: A single credential entry that failed to deserialize from the store file, retaining its raw JSON and the parse error for diagnostics.

nodes.name: LoadedKeyStore
nodes.summary: Result of loading the credentials file: the parsed KeyStore plus any invalid/retired credential entries encountered, with helpers to log diagnostics and surface load errors.

nodes.name: CliOAuthTokenSync
nodes.summary: Snapshot of OAuth tokens (access/refresh/id) received from a launched CLI agent, used to reconcile with what's stored in the key vault.

nodes.name: CliOAuthTokenSyncOutcome
nodes.summary: Outcome enum describing whether a CLI-observed OAuth token was written back to the key vault, skipped because the vault held a newer token, or not applicable.

nodes.name: ClaudeCodeRefreshRequest
nodes.summary: Request body for Claude Code's OAuth refresh-token grant.

nodes.name: ClaudeCodeRefreshResponse
nodes.summary: Response body returned by Claude Code's OAuth token endpoint on a successful refresh.

nodes.name: ClaudeCodeRefreshErrorResponse
nodes.summary: Error response shape returned by Claude Code's OAuth token endpoint on a failed refresh.

nodes.name: CodexRefreshRequest
nodes.summary: Request body for Codex's OAuth refresh-token grant.

nodes.name: CodexRefreshResponse
nodes.summary: Response body returned by Codex's OAuth token endpoint on a successful refresh.

nodes.name: CodexRefreshErrorResponse
nodes.summary: Error response shape returned by Codex's OAuth token endpoint on a failed refresh.

nodes.name: KeyService
nodes.summary: Thread-safe service wrapping the credentials file: loads/saves the KeyStore under a file lock, refreshes Claude Code and Codex OAuth tokens, tracks upstream health/failure state per key, and exposes CRUD operations used by Tauri commands.

nodes.name: get_env_for_agent
nodes.summary: Looks up the ModelKey for an agent type (or explicit key id), and builds the map of environment variables (API key, base URL, auth headers) needed to launch that CLI agent with the right credentials; returns an empty map if the key is missing or disabled.

nodes.name: get_proxy_env_for_agent
nodes.summary: Builds the environment variables needed to run a CLI agent through the Orgii proxy, substituting a proxy token/URL for the direct provider credentials, matching the env var patterns used by the market worker's proxy path.

nodes.name: log_diagnostics
nodes.summary: Logs a warning with details about credential entries that failed to load, for troubleshooting store corruption.

nodes.name: invalid_credential_error
nodes.summary: Builds a ValidationResult describing why a specific key id could not be loaded from the store.

nodes.name: ensure_any_valid_credentials
nodes.summary: Returns an error if the loaded store contains no valid credentials at all, distinguishing a fully-empty store from one where every entry failed to parse.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a KeyService rooted at a given storage directory, ensuring the directory exists.

nodes.name: load_store_checked
nodes.summary: Loads and parses the credentials file, returning a LoadedKeyStore that separates successfully-parsed keys from entries that failed to deserialize.

nodes.name: save_store
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the KeyStore back to the credentials file under the service's file lock.

nodes.name: update_store
nodes.summary: Loads the store, applies a caller-supplied mutation closure, and saves the result, all under a single lock acquisition.

nodes.name: list_keys
nodes.summary: Returns all stored keys, silently dropping entries that fail to load.

nodes.name: list_keys_checked
nodes.summary: Returns all stored keys along with diagnostics about any entries that failed to load.

nodes.name: get_key_checked
nodes.summary: Looks up a key by agent type and optional id, returning a descriptive error if the store fails to load or the key isn't found.

nodes.name: get_key_by_id_checked
nodes.summary: Looks up a key by id only, returning a descriptive error if the store fails to load or the key isn't found.

nodes.name: get_key
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper over get_key_checked that discards the error and returns an Option.

nodes.name: get_key_by_id
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper over get_key_by_id_checked that discards the error and returns an Option.

nodes.name: get_all_keys_for_agent
nodes.summary: Returns every stored key configured for a given agent type.

nodes.name: save_key
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a ModelKey in the store and persists the change.

nodes.name: record_observed_reasoning
nodes.summary: Updates a key's stored reasoning/model metadata based on values observed live from a CLI agent session, and persists the change.

nodes.name: sync_cli_oauth_tokens_if_current
nodes.summary: Reconciles OAuth tokens observed from a launched CLI session with the stored key, only overwriting when the CLI's token is newer than what's already stored, to avoid clobbering a concurrent refresh.

nodes.name: reset_oauth_refresh_failures
nodes.summary: Clears the recorded OAuth refresh failure count/timestamp for a key after a successful refresh.

nodes.name: record_oauth_refresh_failure
nodes.summary: Increments and persists a key's OAuth refresh failure count and last error message.

nodes.name: mark_claude_oauth_upstream_health
nodes.summary: Records the latest upstream health status (rate-limited, error type, retry-after) reported by Claude Code's OAuth-backed API for a key.

nodes.name: clear_claude_oauth_upstream_health
nodes.summary: Clears any recorded upstream health degradation for a Claude Code OAuth key once it recovers.

nodes.name: is_key_temporarily_unavailable
nodes.summary: Checks whether a key is currently within a temporary-unavailable window set by a prior upstream failure.

nodes.name: temporary_unavailable_message
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable message describing why and until when a key is temporarily unavailable.

nodes.name: reset_oauth_refresh_failure_state
nodes.summary: Clears the OAuth refresh failure fields on a key entry in place.

nodes.name: oauth_refresh_lock_for_key
nodes.summary: Returns (creating if needed) a per-key async mutex used to serialize concurrent OAuth refresh attempts for the same key.

nodes.name: claude_code_oauth_key_needs_refresh
nodes.summary: Checks whether a Claude Code OAuth key's access token is expired or near-expiry and needs refreshing.

nodes.name: claude_code_oauth_key_needs_refresh_inner
nodes.summary: Core expiry-comparison logic shared by the public needs-refresh check, given an explicit expiry and current time.

nodes.name: ensure_claude_code_oauth_key_fresh
nodes.summary: Refreshes a Claude Code OAuth key's access token if it is expired or near-expiry, under the per-key refresh lock.

nodes.name: refresh_claude_code_oauth_key
nodes.summary: Performs the actual Claude Code OAuth refresh-token exchange against Anthropic's token endpoint, updates the stored key with the new tokens, and records success/failure health state.

nodes.name: jwt_expires_at
nodes.summary: Decodes a JWT's payload (without verifying the signature) to extract its `exp` claim as an expiry timestamp.

nodes.name: codex_oauth_key_needs_refresh
nodes.summary: Checks whether a Codex OAuth key's id token is expired or near-expiry and needs refreshing.

nodes.name: ensure_codex_oauth_key_fresh
nodes.summary: Refreshes a Codex OAuth key's tokens if needed, under the per-key refresh lock.

nodes.name: refresh_codex_oauth_key
nodes.summary: Performs the Codex OAuth refresh-token exchange, updates the stored key with the new tokens, and records success/failure health state, parsing structured error responses when the refresh is rejected.

nodes.name: merge_key_account_metadata
nodes.summary: Merges freshly-fetched account metadata (e.g. plan/org info) into a key's stored metadata and persists the change.

nodes.name: update_key_health
nodes.summary: Updates a key's health status, error message, available/enabled models, quota info and model context lengths after a validation or live usage check, and persists the change.

nodes.name: delete_key
nodes.summary: Removes a key from the store by agent type and id and persists the change.

nodes.name: delete_key_by_id
nodes.summary: Removes a key from the store by id alone and persists the change.

nodes.name: get_storage_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the directory the credentials file is stored in.

nodes.name: get_storage_file
nodes.summary: Returns the full path to the credentials file.

nodes.name: deserialize_key_store
nodes.summary: Parses the raw contents of the credentials file into a KeyStore plus a list of invalid entries that failed to deserialize, tolerating partial corruption.

nodes.name: serialize_key_store
nodes.summary: Serializes a KeyStore back to JSON for writing to disk, re-merging any retired/invalid credential entries so they aren't silently dropped.

nodes.name: parse_codex_refresh_error
nodes.summary: Parses a Codex OAuth refresh error response body into a structured CodexRefreshErrorResponse.
